name: @arena/read-model
description: Canonical read models over the B002 control plane for Arena (Work Order B005; issue #71): pure, side-effect-free projections of versioned ControlPlaneRecords into frozen, version-stamped read shapes that carry record id, tenant id, kind, record version, data, revision, as-stored provenance and an injected read-at timestamp. Includes a typed read-query vocabulary (by-id, by-kind scroll with opaque continuation tokens, by-tenant listing) with bounded page sizes. This package is a PROJECTION, never a second authority: no state, no writes, no caching — versions, provenance and tenant boundaries are READ from the control plane, never recomputed.
